text:
sam p: Hey team — kicking off Trident POC. Customer is Trident Labs (primary contact Elena). High-level ask: validate RAG for support search + guided responses. We need to align success criteria, security requirements, and pricing constraints before the kickoff call.

maria g: I can take infra/runbook. Need clarity on deployment mode (VPC vs hosted), SSO, and whether they require CMK/KMS.

alex r: FYI sales note: Trident has a hard pilot budget of $30k for 4 weeks. If we go Dedicated/on‑prem that eats up most of it. Can we scope a hosted + VPC peering plan?

jordan (solutions): Proposed success criteria (suggested):
- correctness: conversational QA F1 >= 0.82 on their eval set
- retrieval: embedding recall@5 >= 0.90
- perf: p95 latency < 300ms for typical queries, 99th < 450ms
- cost: platform cost <= $X per 100k tokens (tbd by alex)
Also need an eval harness (200–300 customer queries) and prompt templates.

sam p: Quick logistics checklist to confirm with Trident:
```
- Stakeholders + contact info (Slack/email)
- Pilot timeline: 4 weeks (W0 onboarding, W1 ingest+baseline eval, W2 tuning, W3 UAT)
- Data export: 200 sample support queries + doc corpus
- Security: SSO, DPA, vendor questionnaire, KMS needs
- Access: S3 read-only or secure upload link
- Success gates and rollback criteria
```

maria g: For Private/VPC: we'll need subnet IDs, allowed egress CIDR, peering window, and an IAM role for ingestion. If they require CMK, we need key policy details. Legal also flagged DPA + SOC checklist.

alex r: On pricing — I'll draft two options: (A) hosted trial with token quota + overage, (B) short Dedicated seat for predictable throughput. Will confirm numbers with finance and post later today.

sam p: @sec-ops-bot can you share the standard security questionnaire link and estimated turnaround?

sec-ops-bot: Here you go — https://redwood.internal/sec-questionnaires/trident-2026-fill. Turnaround usually 3–5 business days once customer completes the form.

jordan (solutions): Prompt/eval plan: I'll assemble a 200-query eval and a 20-case prompt adversarial set. I'll DM Elena to request queries and sample docs.

maria g: Potential blocker: legal wants a signed DPA before we provision any Private infra. That could push onboarding by ~5 business days. If Trident can accept hosted API with IP allowlist, we can start earlier.

alex r: Note — if they insist on on‑prem package, lead time is 6–8 weeks for engineering + infra scheduling. Call that out in the kickoff.

sam p: Next steps:
- Alex: pricing draft (EOD)
- Maria: detailed infra ask list & minimal network changes for hosted+VPC (tomorrow)
- Jordan: eval harness + prompt set (prepare draft by Wed)
- Sam: schedule kickoff call with Trident — proposing Tue 10am PT, 45min

Elena (Trident): Thanks — Tue 10am PT works for us. We'll aim to surface 200 sample queries by Monday.

sam p: Great — tagging follow-ups: @alex r, @maria g, @jordan (solutions). :thumbsup:

maria g: I'll prepare a short runbook for onboarding steps to share on the kickoff call.

alex r: I'll include a contingency pricing note for extensions beyond 4 weeks.

jordan (solutions): I'll also add a small checklist for eval metrics + how we'll instrument results in the Console (per-route latency and token cost breakdown).

sam p: If anything else pops up, add to this thread. Otherwise I'll send calendar invite after Alex posts the pricing. Thanks everyone.
